The '''''Evening Star''''' was a [[Corona-class transport|''Corona''-class transport]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] a group of rebel agents piloted the ''Evening Star'' to the [[Kantel system]] during the [[Mynock virus]] outbreak.
